### 2. Summary of Determinations, Calls Made, and Governing Basis (as of 07/14/2025)

#### A. Determination 1 (Request Item 1): Written Confirmation of Available Capacity on Feeder `ALN-108`
- **Call Made**: **DENIED / CANNOT CONFIRM 3.0 MW AVAILABLE CAPACITY.** Alleniom Utilities cannot confirm that `3.0 MW` (`3,000 kW`) of available capacity remains current on Feeder `ALN-108`. Both the `3.0 MW` published figure on `HCM-2024-Q2` (`05/15/2024`) and the `1.8 MW` (`1,800 kW`) interim figure in `PLN-ALN-108-2024-10` (`10/15/2024`) have been reduced by post-publication queue activity.
- **Authoritative Figure Carried in the Response**: **`0.8 MW` (`800 kW`)** working netted available capacity as of **`07/14/2025`**.
- **Basis & Queue Reconciliation**:
  - **Published Baseline (`HCM-2024-Q2`, published `05/15/2024`, Last Study Date `04/2024`)**: Lists Feeder `ALN-108` (`Elderpine` substation, `13.2 kV`, `Pure Generation`) at **`3.0 MW` (`3,000 kW`)**. Under `HCM-2024-Q2` Title Block Row 16 (*Applicability*), a pre-application capacity response is prepared against the published value as adjusted for queue entries added since publication. Pre-publication active queue entries **`PXA-2023-0894`** (Ravenford Data Services — *Ravenford Campus Rooftop PV*, **`1.1 MW` / `1,100 kW`**, queued `2023-11-20` [`11/20/2023`], status: `ISA executed`) and **`PXA-2024-0091`** (Fenwyn Industries Corp — *Fenwyn Facility 3 Array*, **`690 kW` / `0.69 MW`**, queued `2024-04-03` [`04/03/2024`], status: `construction`) — totaling **`1.79 MW` (`1,790 kW`)** — were queued prior to `05/15/2024` and are already accounted for in the `3.0 MW` baseline (`PLN-ALN-108-2024-10` §2–§3).
  - **Less Post-Publication Queue Addition #1 (`PXA-2024-0231`)**: Grantwyck Solar LLC — *Grantwyck ALN-108 Field Solar*, **`1.2 MW` (`1,200 kW`)**, `Pure Generation`, queued **`2024-09-18` (`09/18/2024`)**, current status: `system impact study`. Netted in `PLN-ALN-108-2024-10` (`10/15/2024`), reducing interim working capacity to **`1.8 MW` (`1,800 kW`)** (`3.0 MW − 1.2 MW = 1.8 MW`).
  - **Less Post-Publication Queue Addition #2 (`PXA-2025-0044`)**: Cindermere Renewables LLC — *Cindermere Feeder Site A*, **`1.0 MW` (`1,000 kW`)**, queued **`2025-02-06` (`02/06/2025`)**, current status: `technical screening`. Queued after `10/15/2024`, requiring an additional `1.0 MW` deduction (`1.8 MW − 1.0 MW = 0.8 MW`).
  - **Netted Working Available Capacity as of `07/14/2025`**: **`0.8 MW` (`800 kW`)** (`3.0 MW` baseline − `2.20 MW` [`2.2 MW` / `2,200 kW`, or `73.3%` of the published figure] post-publication additions = `0.8 MW`). Total active queue capacity across all four applications on `ALN-108` is **`3.99 MW` (`3,990 kW`)**, and on-hold queue capacity on `ALN-108` in `2025-07-14_On_Hold_Queue_Report.xlsx` is **`0.0 MW` (`0 kW`)**.

#### B. Determination 2 (Request Item 2): Known Conditions, Restrictions, Upgrade Indications & Sizing Guidance
- **Call Made**: **RESTRICTIONS & UPGRADE INDICATIONS IDENTIFIED; RESIZING CAP OF `≤ 0.8 MW` (`800 kW`) ADVISED TO FIT CURRENT WORKING HEADROOM.**
- **Basis & Advisories to Requester**:
  1. **Impact of Filing at `3.0 MW-AC` (`3.9 MW-DC`)**: Exceeds the `0.8 MW` remaining working headroom by **`2.2 MW` (`2,200 kW`)**. Classified as **Medium-Scale DER (`1 MW – 5 MW`)** under APUC Interconnection Tariff Vol. III, `§12.2(b)` and `DIS-01 Rev 4 §3 Table 3-1`. Filing at `3.0 MW-AC` will fail initial technical screening and Supplemental Review Procedure `SRP-3 Rev 3 §3 Screen A` & `§5(c)` (aggregate DER penetration), require a full **System Impact Study (`SIS`)** under the DER Planning Group (`Ivo Grantham`), and likely trigger substantial applicant-funded thermal, voltage, and/or protection system upgrades.
  2. **Resizing Option (`≤ 0.8 MW` / `800 kW`)**: Consistent with Northline's stated intent to sit at or below feeder headroom, sizing within current working capacity on `ALN-108` requires reducing the requested AC interconnection capacity to **`≤ 0.8 MW` (`800 kW`)** (`Commercial Small-Scale DER`, `500 kW – 1 MW` under `Tariff §12.2(a)` and `DIS-01 Rev 4 Table 3-1 & Table 5-1 Category 2`).
  3. **Controlled-Capacity Recognition (`DIS-01 Rev 4 §3.1 & §3.6`)**: Aggregate inverter AC nameplate governs unless Northline submits **both** (1) a valid `UL 1741` / `UL 3141` Power Control System (`PCS`) certification (`CEL-2025-Q2`) and (2) an approved site-specific **Control Narrative** at application intake.
  4. **Queue Position & Prohibition on Post-Filing / Post-ISA Capacity Amendments (`Tariff §12.3, §12.6, §12.7`; `DIS-01 Rev 4 §7`; `POL-QM-05 Rev 3 §2.4`)**: A pre-application request does not establish a queue position or reserve headroom (`Tariff §12.3`). Formal applications are processed in queue order behind `PXA-2023-0894`, `PXA-2024-0091`, `PXA-2024-0231`, and `PXA-2025-0044` (`Tariff §12.7`), and material modifications to capacity or POI require withdrawal and re-application with a new queue date (`Tariff §12.6`, `DIS-01 Rev 4 §7`, `POL-QM-05 Rev 3 §2.4`).
  5. **Telemetry, POI Protection & Equipment Lead-Time Advisory (`TCS-02 §5`, `DPS-07 Rev 2 §4.2`, `DIS-01 Rev 4 §5 Table 5-1`, `OG-17`, `SCADA-EQP-2025-06`)**: All in-scope projects (`≥ 500 kW`) require utility-owned RTU and live SOC SCADA telemetry prior to PTO (`TCS-02 §5`), and `Category 3` (`1 MW – 5 MW`) export projects also require a utility-owned POI recloser (`DPS-07 Rev 2 §4.2`). Current supplier lead times for utility RTUs and POI reclosers are approximately **8 months** (`SCADA-EQP-2025-06`), with deployment prioritized under `OG-17`.
  6. **Alternative Elderpine `13.2 kV` Pure-Generation Feeders (`ALN-097` and `ALN-103`)**: Adjacent Elderpine `13.2 kV` pure-generation feeders **`ALN-097`** (**`6.1 MW`** published available on `HCM-2024-Q2`) and **`ALN-103`** (**`5.5 MW`** published available on `HCM-2024-Q2`) have **zero (`0`)** active or on-hold queue entries as of `07/14/2025` and can be evaluated during the pre-application dialogue if Northline requires a full `3.0 MW` POI.

#### C. Determination 3 (Request Item 3): Pre-Application Dialogue Meeting
- **Call Made**: **APPROVED / GRANTED.** Offered a Pre-Application Dialogue Meeting with `June Halloway` (Distribution Planning), `Meera Vellanki` (Interconnection Studies), and `Ivo Grantham` (DER Planning Group), logged in OpenProject under **Work Package `#48`**.

#### D. Internal Map Maintenance & Interim Study Supersession Flagged (`Work Package #47`)
- **Supersession of `PLN-ALN-108-2024-10` (§4–§5)**: Directed Distribution Planning (`June Halloway`) to reissue/supersede `PLN-ALN-108-2024-10` (`10/15/2024`, `1.8 MW`) to incorporate `PXA-2025-0044` (`1.0 MW`, queued `02/06/2025`) and establish **`0.8 MW` (`800 kW`)** as the updated working interim figure as of `07/14/2025`.
- **Priority Feeder Re-Study & Hosting Capacity Map Refresh (`RA-2025-07-01 §3.7` & `HCM-2024-Q2` Title Block Row 11)**: Requested a priority feeder-level planning re-study and quarterly Hosting Capacity Map refresh for Feeder `ALN-108`, documenting qualification under all three published prioritization criteria: (1) earliest pending post-publication queue/pre-app dates (`09/18/2024`, `02/06/2025`, `07/02/2025`); (2) requested capacity relative to published available figure (`2.20 MW` / `73.3%` queued post-publication + `3.0 MW` / `100%` pre-app request); and (3) `Pure Generation` (`100%` export) category weighting.
